focus: Consolidate the mechanism, per-path hazard table, two-clause fix, test set, residual risks and scope limits

findings.label: The mechanism in one sentence: a fork inherits the parent's `session_id` and the platform emits `SessionStart` with `source: compact` inside it, so every session-keyed path resolves the parent's state while the hook's only gate is the very value the platform sets for a fork.

The hazard table: compact-pointer emits the parent's pointer and zeroes the parent's nudge level; session-prime injects the parent's compact brief and records a compaction boundary for the parent's session; spec-gate shares the parent's gate record; `claim` would accept a fork's claim of the parent's note; stop-arm and the PostToolUse nudge share the same keying but are not dispatched inside forks today.

The parent never compacted on 2026-10-21: six compact_boundary records exist, the last at 2026-10-20T16:19:05.871Z, and the parent transcript's last `SessionStart:compact` attachment is 2026-10-20T16:19:06.293Z, while three forks fired the pointer at 14:44, 15:30 and 17:42.

The fix is two clauses plus a reorder: emit only when the payload's transcript holds a compact_boundary strictly after the note's `created_at`, record one delivery per (note, boundary) so later fires for the same boundary stay silent, and move `writeState(sessionId, 0)` below every guard.

Four tests prove it: boundary-after-note emits and resets the level; no-boundary emits nothing and leaves the level intact; boundary-before-note emits nothing; a missing transcript emits nothing and logs `compact-pointer-skipped reason=no-transcript`.
The residual risk after the fix is a parent that compacts, ignores its own pointer and leaves the note open, which clause two covers by suppressing the repeat rather than by re-emitting it to a fork.

The fix does not depend on the one value still unproven locally, the fork's `transcript_path`, because the boundary guard behaves identically whether that path names the fork's transcript or the parent's.

ruledOut.direction: Add an agent-identity check to the payload
ruledOut.reason: The documented payload contract carries no agent field.

ruledOut.direction: Register a SubagentStart marker hook to disable the pointer for forks
